hello.Text: Hello there my friend.  Perhaps I can interest you in some of my weapons, armor, or other wares?

Text: I've been tinkering with a new piece of equipment.  It will take some of the things from around the port and adapt them.  You can buy them from my sale stock.
{delay 1}To shop - press the button below marked with the symbol of a Shopping Cart.  It will give you an overview of the current stock.

{delay 4}\nEach weapon requires you to provide different materials for the Adaptation Factory.  I can give you an idea of what materials it needs for a specific weapon.  What type of weapon were you looking for?

ranged.Text: I'd be glad to tell you about guns. What type of gun would you like to know about?

melee.Text: I'd be glad to tell you about melee weapons.  What type of weapon would you like to know about?

special.Text: I'd be glad to tell you about special weapons.  What type of weapon would you like to know about?

Text: I have some armor for newcomers. It may be refurbished, but it will help to protect you.

{delay 2}\nI've heard that the Omni-Tek and Clan vendors here are working on improvements for this armor, but you would need to talk to them about that. They might not be too keen on talking to anyone who has not joined their side though.

h_shotgun.Text: To improve the shotgun, you need to polish the inside of the barrel.  You might try looking to see if you can find materials from the Tropical Stalkers to the south-west.

h_pistol.Text: You might have noticed the power supply on the pistol is underpowered.  Maybe you can find a new power supply for the pistol on one of the Cargo Droids on the docks.

h_submachine_gun.Text: That submachine gun really needs a stock to stabilize it during burst fire.  The Adaptation Factory could probably use bone plates from the Malle to the south-west to make a folding stock.

h_rifle.Text: The scopes on those rifles just don't work right.  I'll bet a new scope could be made with some of the optical components from the Cargo Droids on the docks though.

h_assault_rifle.Text: The barrel on that assault rifle heats up quickly during firing. Some of the byproducts carried by the Waste Collectors on the docks could be used to treat the barrel, which would help alleviate the problem.

h_energy_weapon.Text: The plasma weapon just doesn't heat up the plasma enough.  An extra chamber for heating up plasma might do the trick.  Check the Waste Collectors on the docks, they might have a fuel chamber that could be adapted for that purpose.

h_sword.Text: The cross guard of that weapon really doesn't protect you enough.  A really stylish replacement might be made from the bones of one of those Leets on the beach.

h_broadsword.Text: I never liked the grip on that broadsword, too slippery for my taste.  The Adaptation Factory could probably make some good grip tape for it from the skin of one of the Reef Salamanders to the south-west.

Text: A really creepy way to improve that bat would be to add a reet beak whistle to it. You can find Island Reets on the beach, just feed one of their beaks into the Adaptation Factory.
{delay 2}You might also try adapting a power supply from the Cargo Droids on the docks, that would make it a 'shockingly' powerful weapon.

h_hammer.Text: The head of that hammer is none too sturdy.  I'll bet the Adaptation Factory could make a replacement from some of the dense bone material in the skull of a Malle, which are found to the south-west.

h_dirk.Text: Most people don't know that there is an injection system in those dirks.  If you find some poison from the Shore Snakes on the beach, you could make a cartridge of toxins to install in the dirk.

h_grenade_launcher.Text: The launcher mechanism on the launcher isn't very high power.  I've adapted a design from a pnuematic launcher developed by a man named Nizno, but you'll need a compression chamber from the Waste Collectors on the docks to make the conversion.

h_bow.Text: That bow is a classic.  I've always wanted to put a natural gut string on it though, you might try the viscera of the Rollerrats to the south-west for the materials.

h_shield.Text: I've looked at the blueprints for that shield, and there is a slot for an additional chemical injector.  Some bile from the Reef Salamanders to the south-west would be perfect to make an extra injector.
